geometry_note.what_the_round_asked_for: reuse the existing mask geometry: take the crossing series out of the plan's scope so that series falls to identity
geometry_note.what_the_instrument_actually_has: ``plan.excluded_series`` indexes TRAINING series -- BudgetedSearch._masked builds {uid: program or None} over train_uids -- while ``min_per_series_gain`` reads the EVALUATION series vector.  In this cohort the two rosters are disjoint: 12 training uids (722.../744...) against 4 evaluation uids (99999...).  Writing evaluation ids into excluded_series would mask nothing and report a rescope that did not happen -- the placebo shape #19 exists to prevent.
geometry_note.what_was_built_instead: the action writes its own plan key, identity_routed_eval_series, and the two window readings are projected off the vectors the instrument already measured: a series served identity has gain exactly zero by the definition of gain, and a series left in scope keeps its measured number because the batch is fitted on the training pool.  aggregate_gain is the mean of the per-series vector, verified on all 70 banked gains dicts to 2.8e-17, so the projection is exact and costs no measurement.
geometry_note.what_this_costs_in_claim_strength: the deployment this models is per-series model routing: serve the cleaned-pool model to the series the plan helps and the identity model to the ones it hurts.  That is a real rule, but the routing is chosen on the same window it is scored on, exactly as the veto is; and nothing downstream of the gate -- _plan_label, the Experience lifecycle, the Skill payloads -- reads the new plan key yet.  This round does not run it live.

guard.rationale: The observed recalled plan had positive aggregate delayed gain while one evaluation series lost -0.1255567, far below the declared -0.005 harm line. Rescoping only evaluation series below that line preserves the plan elsewhere, uses the measured per-series vector, and avoids an additional Consumer retrain.

predicted_data_effect: On recalled-skill adoptions, each evaluation series with delayed gain below -0.005 is served identity while unaffected evaluation series retain the adopted program.
For the observed episode, series 99999904140 is removed from the program scope and the other three evaluation series remain in scope.
falsification_condition: The runtime fails to rescope an evaluation series whose delayed gain is below -0.005 on a recalled-skill adoption.
After rescoping, the guard still fires for the remaining in-scope evaluation series and the resulting identity fallback performs worse than the unguarded plan under the declared harm criterion.
proposal.reason: The authorized verification surface is empty, and the public episode shows the specific risk gap: aggregate adoption concealed a material per-series loss. The min_per_series_gain statistic is the only legal basis for identifying affected series, and RESCOPE_MASK_HARMED_SERIES is the narrowest available action because it preserves the selected program for evaluation series that did not cross the harm line. Limiting applicability to reused-skill adoptions matches the observed DIRECT_RECALL path and avoids changing fresh-search adoption behavior without evidence.
